description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingsModelFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It verifies immutability, creation of Features from JSON objects, and handles invalid input scenarios, including exceptions during JSON parsing.

classes.name: ThingsModelFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the static methods in ThingsModelFactory, focusing on features creation and validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ThingsModelFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: newFeatures
methods.description: Verifies that a Features object is correctly created from a valid JSON object containing features.

methods.name: newFeaturesWithNullLiteral
methods.description: Tests creation of Features when JSON contains null literals.

methods.name: newFeaturesWithNullObject
methods.description: Tests creation of Features when JSON contains null objects.

methods.name: fromJsonOfEmptyArrayStringFailsWithException
methods.description: Ensures that passing an empty array string to newFeatureDefinition throws a FeatureDefinitionEmptyException.

methods.name: createInvalidFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that an invalid feature ID format causes a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createTooLargeFeatureId
methods.description: Verifies that feature IDs exceeding maximum length trigger a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidAttribute
methods.description: Ensures that invalid attribute key formats cause a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createTooLargeAttribute
methods.description: Checks that attribute keys exceeding maximum allowed length cause a JsonKeyInvalidException.
